text:
If I were looking for a job, it would definitely be a company from the B-corp community (https://lnkd.in/dh4PfPFZ). It would be important for them to have an opportunity to influence the environment and society. That's why we want to become a B-corp company too — we want to work with passionate people like us. Yes we want to make money, but we also want to influence the world that we live in.
